data.name: Agustin
data.long_meaning: From the Latin name 'Augustus', meaning 'majestic, great, venerable'. In Roman mythology, the name was borne by several emperors, including Augustus Caesar, who ruled the Roman Empire from 27 BC to 14 AD.

in_hebrew.name: אגוסטין
in_hebrew.long_meaning: השם אגוסטין מקורו בלטינית ומשמעותו 'גדול, כבוד, מחשבה רבה'. השם נגזר מהשורש הלטיני 'augustus' שפירושו 'מועלה, רם, גדול'. באותיותיו הרומיות הוא מייצג את הרומאים והשפעתו ניכרת גם בתרבות הנוצרית, שם הוא מזוהה עם קדושים ומנהיגים בכירים.

in_greek.name: Αυγούστινος
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο όρος Αυγούστινος είναι η ελληνική εκδοχή του λατινικού ονόματος Augustinus. Η ετυμολογία του συνδέεται με το λατινικό 'augustus', που σημαίνει 'μεγάλος, σεβαστός'. Στην παράδοση της Εκκλησίας, το όνομα συνδέεται με τον Άγιο Αυγουστίνο της Ιππώνας, έναν από τους σημαντικότερους Πατέρες της Εκκλησίας.

in_latin.name: Agustin
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Agustin originem ducit a latino 'augustus', quod significat 'magnificus, maximus'. In traditione christiana, nomen hoc saepe cum sanctis et viris illustribus coniungitur. Etymologia latina indicat magnitudinem et excellentiam, quae in cultura christiana sunt virtutes magnae.

in_english.name: Agustin
in_english.long_meaning: The name Agustin originates from the Latin 'augustus', meaning 'great, magnificent, exalted'. It has strong roots in Christian tradition, associated with Saint Augustine of Hippo, a pivotal figure in Christian theology. The name symbolizes greatness, dignity, and spiritual elevation, resonating with Christian values of humility and devotion.

saint_reference.note: A prominent Christian theologian and philosopher.

data.cultural_impact: The name Augustin has been popular among Christians due to the early Christian Saint Augustine of Hippo, who was born in the late 4th century AD. St. Augustine is arguably one of the most influential figures in Christian theology, and his thoughts have shaped Western Christian thought for centuries. Known for his writings on philosophy and theology, Augustine's work "Confessions" is considered a classic in both literature and spirituality.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Augustin has deep spiritual significance for Christians, as it evokes the virtues of majesty, greatness, and veneration associated with St. Augustine of Hippo. Augustine's writings emphasize the importance of faith and God's grace in the spiritual journey. Named after this saint, an individual named Augustin is reminded of the importance of seeking wisdom, understanding, and a deep spiritual connection with divine power. The name serves as a constant reminder of the virtues of perseverance, humility, and introspection on the path to enlightenment.

historical_references.reference: Agustin of Hippo (354-430 AD) was a Christian bishop, philosopher, and theologian of the Roman African Church whose writings influenced the development of Western Christianity and Western philosophy.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Agustin remains relevant in modern Christian society, representing a bridge between traditional Biblical values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Christian names.

name_in_real_life.story: Hannah Agustin from Jerusalem, Israel embodies the meaning of Agustin - "Majestic, great, venerable". Raised in a Christian family, they were taught to honor the significance of their name and walk in faith throughout their life.
